_comment: Scoped permission allowlist for the unattended evening Market Context run (claude -p, headless). Covers ONLY what the /market-context skill needs: the sweep, the drill scripts it writes under scratch/context_checks/, the Slack sender, and file read/write. NO blanket bypass and NO web tools: this product computes every claim from local history (spec section 2), which is what makes the scoped allowlist strictly better than the daily pitch's bypassPermissions. The deny list still hard-blocks secret files, because a scoped session that can write files and post to Slack is an exfiltration path if anything ever does reach it. Grep is deliberately absent: it dumps file contents and cannot be path-scoped.
